messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty: page fired for service=runtime-eu-west latency.p99 > 1200ms (threshold=800ms). PD incident: PD12345. Automatic notification to oncall rotation.

marta: Acked PD12345. I'm on it. Pulling console metrics now.

marta: Console link: https://console.redwood.ai/metrics/runtime-eu-west?range=5m -- p95 trending up ~420ms, p99 spike at ~1.3s. No error increase yet.

devon: Looking at autoscaler logs. Noticed a scale-up throttle in the last 4m. Might be hitting quota on cores for that pool.

sara: Checking model sidecars and KV cache. KV miss rate spiked ~3x ~2m ago. Could be a cache warmup/regression after recent rollout.

alex: Can we route to a smaller model variant temporarily? That reduces tokenization overhead.

marta: Good idea. Creating a short-lived routing override to fallback-ram-quantized. Pushing canary rule now.

marta: `curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/route-override -d '{"service":"runtime-eu-west","route":"fallback-quantized","duration":"5m"}'`

ops-bot: deploy-bot: canary route applied to 12% of traffic for service runtime-eu-west.

devon: Autoscaler shows pending scale requests. Manually triggering a burst scale to add 4 GPUs to the dedicated pool.

devon: `gcloud compute instances managed resize gpu-pool-eu-west --size=16` (started)

sara: I see sidecar mem usage high on a few hosts; evicting large KV segments on cluster nodes causing temporary latency. Initiating gentle eviction: `rdw-kvtool evict --pattern=large-prefix-* --grace=45s`

marta: Noting customer impact: internal dashboard shows increase in API end-to-end latency for apps using chat and embeddings in EU region. No 5xx increase, just tail latency affecting interactive flows. Marking as Sev2 until p99 < 900ms.

alex: After route override and KV evict, p99 fell from 1300ms -> ~760ms within 60s. Keeping monitoring.

marta: Great. Keep route at 12% and monitor autoscaler. If p99 holds under 900ms for 3 consecutive 1m windows, we'll scale back routing override.

devon: Autoscaler resize completed. New instances joining. Will update when fully healthy.

ops-bot: infra-bot: new instances are healthy (3/3 services ready) in pool gpu-pool-eu-west.

sara: Sidecar memory pressure reduced after eviction. KV miss rate slowly decreasing.

marta: PD12345: acknowledged -> assigned to marta. Status: mitigating. Estimated customer impact: increased latency for EU interactive requests, degraded UX but no errors.

alex: Suggest we add short-term alert suppression for noisy p99 spikes to avoid duplicate pages while mitigation is active.

marta: Agree. Suppressing p99 alert for 10m for runtime-eu-west (note: still tracking in dashboard).

marta: Check-in 5m: p99 steady at ~700-800ms, autoscaler healthy, route override at 12%, KV warmed to normal hit rate.

devon: Afterscale health good. Recommend scaling down fallback routing slowly to avoid churn.

sara: I'll run a postmortem probe to see if recent model rollout correlated with KV invalidations. Capturing traces and promptset samples.

marta: Moving to close loop: will keep monitoring for 20m, then remove suppression and gradually roll back override. If everything stays green, we'll resolve PD12345 as mitigated and follow up with RCA.

marta: PD12345: resolved by marta at 1759012525. Final note: root cause likely combination of cache invalidation plus autoscaler throttle; follow-up RCA assigned to sara + devon.

sara: Copy. I'll start RCA draft and post in #postmortems once initial data is collected.

alex: Thx team :thumbsup:

incident-bot: PagerDuty: PD12345 closed (resolved by marta).
